correctness.rationale: Every proper retraction fixes a unique connected path, hence is a bounded endpoint-to-endpoint walk on the complementary cycle arc. The dihedral image stabilizer has order two; its reflection acts on walks by reversal and complement, whose fixed points are counted exactly by central vertex or edge transfer-matrix entries. Orbit-stabilizer supplies the complete n and 2n orbit sizes. Fibonacci four-vertex path walks lower-bound all retractions, and half-walk determination upper-bounds fixed maps. An exact direct-composition and dihedral-conjugacy census passes n=4 through n=16, including odd cases. No computation is substituted for universal proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2023 cycle-endomorphism monoid preprint concerns Green relations, regularity, total counts and generators, not conjugacy of its idempotents under the unit group. The strongest closely relevant published result counts labeled idempotents by rank, yielding nT but not the fixed-reflection count S or orbit sizes. The path reflection-orbit result has different two-tail geometry; its formulas do not supply the cycle-arc midpoint transfer. The 2009 congruence-count paper is only partially accessible, creating a historical-priority risk. No claim of exhaustive literature coverage or independence.
residual_risks: An earlier general Burnside/idempotent orbit theorem for graph endomorphism monoids could imply the result but was not identified.
The 2009 Michels–Knauer full article was not accessible for complete implication comparison; its abstract alone cannot rule out a hidden equivalent result.
The sharp exponential rate for symmetry rarity is not determined; only a correct exponentially decaying upper bound is claimed.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of the idempotent submonoid by conjugation under its intrinsic units: for every even cycle and every image size it distinguishes orbit sizes n and 2n, provides an exact class generating polynomial, and proves exponential symmetry breaking. It adds genuinely different symmetry information beyond known labeled rank counts and handles the full infinite family.
